title: Viborg vs. Lyngby: A Danish League Match That Could Reshape the Table
seoTitle: Viborg vs Lyngby: Danish League Showdown
subtitle: The clash at Energi Viborg Arena promises to reveal the difference in pace between the teams.
excerpt: The match between Viborg and Lyngby, scheduled for September 4th, highlights the disparity between a team aiming for the top and another struggling to climb out of the.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
At Energi Viborg Arena, Viborg has the chance to turn their current form into another step towards the top of the Danish Superliga. On September 4th, at 2:00 PM (Brasília time), the club, third in the table with 13 points from six matches, faces Lyngby, who sits in 11th place with just three points.

Viborg: A Winning Pace and Home Unbeaten Streak

  • The team has won their last three matches, with 15 goals scored and 9 conceded in ten games.
  • At home, they are 100% unbeaten in their last five games, conceding only 0.20 goals per match.
  • In the last round, they secured an away victory, 3-2 over AC Horsens.
  • They have scored 1.80 goals and conceded 0.80 goals in their last five overall performances.

Lyngby: Searching for a First Win and Away Difficulties

  • The club has only three points from six games, with four wins, three draws, and three losses in their last ten confrontations.
  • They have lost all three away matches in the Superliga.
  • On average, they score 0.80 goals and concede 1.20 goals per game in their last five performances.
  • They have only a 40% unbeaten record in their last five away games, including matches from the previous season.

Probabilities and Statistical Prediction

  • Home win probability: 51.0%.
  • Draw probability: 24.0%.
  • Away win probability: 25.0%.
  • The match usually features more than 1.5 goals.

Head-to-Head History

  • The two teams have met three times before, with the last ending 0-0 at Lyngby Stadion.
  • In their last ten matches against each other, Viborg won three, Lyngby won two, and there were five draws.
  • At Energi Viborg Arena, Viborg has three wins and two draws in their last five matches.

What to Expect from the Match

  • Viborg can continue their strong home performance, maintaining pressure on the league leaders.
  • Lyngby needs to break their negative away streak and find defensive solidity.
  • The duel could be decisive for both teams' positions in the table.
